skill_name: Explain how to bake an apple pie.
workflow:
To bake an apple pie, first preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9-inch pie plate with butter or cooking oil and set aside.

Next, make the pie crust. In a large bowl, whisk together 2-1/4 cups flour and 1 teaspoon each of salt and sugar. Cut in 1/2 cup of cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add 4 tablespoons cold water and stir everything together. Knead the dough lightly and form it into a ball. Roll the dough onto a lightly floured surface so that it's about 2 inches larger
